utterances.speaker: JUDGE SHAHABUDDEEN
utterances.text: Ms. Registrar, would you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honour, this is case number IT-02-60-A, the Prosecutor versus Vidoje Blagojevic and Dragan Jokic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SHAHABUDDEEN
utterances.text: Good afternoon to you all. This is a Status Conference in the case of the Prosecution against Blagojevic and Jokic. I would like to begin by ensuring in the usual way that the audio equipment is functioning properly. Mr. Jokic and Mr. Blagojevic, can each of you hear the proceedings in a language you understand? THE APPELLANT JOKIC: [Interpretation] Your Honour, I can hear you and I can understand you fully. THE APPELLANT BLAGOJEVIC: [Interpretation] Your Honour, I can hear and I can understand.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SHAHABUDDEEN
utterances.text: What about each counsel? Mr. Domazet.

utterances.speaker: MR. DOMAZET
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour, Vladimir Domazet. I'm counsel for Vidoje Blagojevic.

utterances.speaker: MS. LINDSAY
utterances.text: Good morning -- good afternoon, Your Honour. Virginia Lindsay. I'm standing in for Professor Peter Murphy on behalf of Mr. Dragan Jokic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SHAHABUDDEEN
utterances.text: I shall have something to say on that point immediately. Let me hear from the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MS. KIND
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. My name is Marie-Ursula Kind for the Prosecution, together with senior counsel, Mr. Norman Farrell and our case manager, Ms. Lourdes Galicia, and we can hear you well. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SHAHABUDDEEN
utterances.text: What I wanted to say is that Mr. Murphy, the lead counsel for Mr. Jokic, had to be away from The Hague today on an urgent personal matter. As co-counsel for Mr. Jokic is also out of the country, Mr. Murphy requested that Mr. Jokic be represented at this Status Conference by Ms. Virginia Lindsay, a legal consultant for Mr. Jokic. I agreed to Mr. Murphy's request. Ms. Lindsay is a member of the Association of Defence Counsel of the ICTY, and she's on the Rule 45 list of Defence counsel. She has represented a number of accused before this Tribunal and is I believe here with us today. I wish to welcome you, Ms. Lindsay. Now I would like to call for the appearances, if I may. There will be Mr. Blagojevic will be represented by Mr. Domazet. Is that right? Mr. Jokic will be represented by Ms. Lindsay. Is that right?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SHAHABUDDEEN
utterances.text: And Prosecution will be represented by Mr. Norman Farrell and Marie-Ursula Kind, with Ms. Kind making the submissions I hope. Yes. Thank you. Now, as you're aware, Rule 65 bis of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence requires that Status Conferences be held for each appellant in the Tribunal's custody at intervals no greater than 120 days. The last Status Conference in this case was held jointly for Mr. Blagojevic on 23 August 2006. A further Status Conference was planned for 4th December 2006 but was cancelled in view of the appeals hearing in this case on the 5th and 6th of December, 2006. As you know, the purposes of Status Conferences are two-fold. First, to allow the appellants to express concerns relating to the appeal and detention conditions; and, secondly, to update the appellants with respect to the status of each case. Now, I shall begin with the second of these objectives by remarking something which you know well, that the Appeals Chamber's hearing of this appeal was on the 5th and 6th December, 2004 [sic]. Judgement will be delivered in due course. There are no pending motions in this case. Would any of the parties like to raise any matter in respect of the status of the appeals? If not, then I would like to ask whether the appellants themselves have any questions or concerns that they would like to raise relating to the conditions of their detention and any other relevant matters. Over to you, Mr. Blagojevic and Mr. Jokic. THE APPELLANT BLAGOJEVIC: [Interpretation] Your Honour, as regards the conditions in the Detention Unit, I have nothing particular to say. I'm receiving medical therapy for my condition; and as for the rest, there is nothing that should be mentioned that has changed from the last Status Conference as regards my conditions of detention.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SHAHABUDDEEN
utterances.text: Thank you, sir. May I hear from your colleague. THE APPELLANT JOKIC: [Interpretation] Your Honour, I have no remarks at this point.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SHAHABUDDEEN
utterances.text: Well, then if there are no further matters to be discussed, we might take the adjournment now. Thank you.
